short_description: New Christie single-laser Dolby Vision system rolling out from May 2025. Lower brightness than dual-laser E3LH (~17 fL estimated vs 31 fL). Same Dolby Vision HDR and Atmos experience.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: New Christie single-projector system (announced March 2025, rolling out May 2025+); ~25,000–30,000 lumens RGB laser
default_projection.contrast_notes: Brightness derived: 25,000–30,000 lumens on ~55×29 ft screen ≈ 16–19 fL; 17.0 fL used as midpoint estimate [source: derived]. Contrast: Dolby claims 'well exceeding a million-to-one' via same dual-modulation DLP principle as E3LH; sequential ~5,000–7,500:1 assumed comparable. One community report suggests brightness may exceed dual-laser at some venues — treat as uncertain pending more reports.

known_limitations: Estimated brightness ~16–19 fL — lower than dual-laser E3LH (~31 fL) due to single projector; treat as derived estimate until confirmed measurements available
Cannot display 1.43:1 IMAX content at full height
Early deployment variant — brightness and contrast data based on announcement specs and limited community reports, not lab measurements
